description: Join an OpenTrain open contribution program as the authenticated talent (personal token). UNPAID open work by design: no contract is created and nothing is payable; accepted contributions build the public track record, portable reputation, and may earn model access. Idempotent when already joined; full programs return 409. You can leave at any time with opentrain_leave_open_program. Requires open-label:write scope and the open_contribution feature.
name: opentrain_join_open_program
